descriptions.dur: Record total flow duration in seconds
descriptions.sttl: Source to destination time to live value
descriptions.dttl: Destination to source time to live value
descriptions.smeansz: Mean packet size transmitted by source
descriptions.dmeansz: Mean packet size transmitted by destination
descriptions.synack: TCP setup time between SYN and SYN-ACK packets
descriptions.ackdat: TCP setup time between SYN-ACK and ACK packets
descriptions.ct_srv_src: Connections containing the same service and source IP in 100 records
descriptions.ct_srv_dst: Connections containing the same service and destination IP in 100 records
descriptions.ct_dst_ltm: Connections to the same destination IP in 100 records
descriptions.ct_src_ltm: Connections from the same source IP in 100 records
descriptions.service: Network service / port mapping (http, ssl, dns, ftp)
descriptions.state: TCP state machine status (FIN, CON, INT)
